definitions.explanation: Having a constructive and enthusiastic attitude. Taking initiative rather than waiting passively.

notes:
{積極的|せっきょくてき} describes a willing, forward-leaning attitude — taking initiative rather than waiting to be told. It is always positive in tone, implying enthusiasm and engagement.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {積極的|せっきょくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (actively, proactively)
- Noun modifier: {積極的|せっきょくてき}な + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {積極的|せっきょくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: tackle something proactively
- {積極的|せっきょくてき}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: positive/proactive attitude
- {積極的|せっきょくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加：02498_sanka⟧: participate actively
- {積極的|せっきょくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}する→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧: speak up actively

SIMILAR WORDS:
{積極的|せっきょくてき} vs ⟦{消極的|しょうきょくてき}→消極的：04779_shoukyokuteki⟧ (passive, reluctant) is a very common antonym pair, often used when evaluating workplace performance or classroom participation.

USAGE:
Unlike English "aggressive," {積極的|せっきょくてき} carries no negative connotation. It is always used approvingly. For aggressive behavior, ⟦{攻撃的|こうげきてき}→攻撃的：06243_kougekiteki⟧ is used instead.
